texts.name: Falok
texts.biography: Falok is the finished product of a cruel experiment. Of the many candidates who have undergone transformation experiments, he is the only one to survive and retain most of his former memories. Although physically indistinguishable from a zombie, his existence proves that reformed humans are not undead monsters.

specialty.description: Increases Speed of any Cyborgs or Cyborg Makers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for 3 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Cyborgs
